_comment: D1 stock parallel gripper — TCP 129 mm MEASURED on d1-3 2026-09-16 (Shu, callipers): the flange-to-pad-tip stack 2 + 7 + 42 + 20 + 58 mm. It supersedes the 136 mm carried over from d1-sdk omakase_arm::ToolConfig::defaultGripper(), which had only the vendor CAD's 143.5 mm jaw tips behind it. Mass/COM unchanged and still validated on the real D1; inertia is a cylinder-approximation estimate.
